text: Hi Pearce, I was wondering where the service event for today was located?

Hey Brandon, I was just wondering about meeting requirements and if we were still doing the two articles to account for two meeting points. I had also messaged someone on exec about this earlier in the school year but I never got a response. I have a class, HNRS 325 that meets on Mondays from 6:30-8:00 which conflicts with most of DDS' speaker meetings. In previous years, students with class conflicts were given a pass because we can't miss class for the meetings but I would like to know what I can do to make up for this. I am happy to send you two dental article summaries and see that on the member forms, that's still an option. I can also try to attend the last couple meetings of the year since I think my last HNRS 325 class is next Monday. Please let me know if this is something you can help me with, I want to remain a dedicated member of DDS (having been one since 2024) but I also can't sacrifice my classes for it.
